source_of_claims: the Geometria stratum: document architecture read mechanically by the shape measures

assertions.claim: A settings reference's work is architectural: the heading hierarchy is the lookup path, and finding a setting without reading prose is the point. Geometria dominates the core.
Deep hierarchy over short sections: headings and two-line bodies keep the layout-chunk median in single digits, the opposite end of the spectrum from narrative prose.
The page's heading tree is four levels deep, and the heading-tree measure reads at least three.
